yearly.title: Yearly settlement
yearly.subtitle: One car's owed split per driver for the year.
yearly.explainer: Variable owed = variable factor × the car's variable total (the factor follows distance, so a non-fueler still pays for km driven). Fixed owed = fixed factor × the car's fixed total. This view shows what each driver owes; paid and net balance are combined across cars — see the combined settlement.

combined.title: Combined settlement
combined.subtitle: Net balance per driver across every car in their group.
combined.explainer: Variable / fixed diff. = what a driver paid of that cost type minus what they owe, summed across every calculated car. Net balance = the two differences added; positive means the group owes the driver. Each column nets to zero.

monthly.title: Monthly distances
monthly.subtitle: Per-driver kilometres by month for a car.
monthly.empty: No aggregated months for this car and year.

factors.title: Distribution factors
factors.subtitle: The factors that split this car's yearly costs. Variable follows distance; fixed is an equal split over the participant group.
factors.explainer: Factors are computed by the yearly run and are read-only here. The fixed factor is always an equal split — over the group of drivers plus anyone added on the participants screen.
